prompt:
Generate 10 unique synthetic training examples for an English text classifier.
Dataset: SST-2
Class: negative
Definition: A movie-review sentence or phrase expressing an overall unfavorable opinion of the film, its storytelling, performances, direction, or other cinematic qualities.
Write English movie-review sentiment examples, NOT customer-service requests or assistant replies. Include both short review phrases/fragments (roughly 2–8 words) and complete review sentences (roughly 9–30 words). The source task includes fragments, so do not turn every example into a polished full review. Vary aspects such as acting, pacing, dialogue, direction, cinematography, and emotional impact. Vary sentence structure, vocabulary, and explicitness; include some natural negation and qualified judgments. The overall sentiment must clearly match the assigned category; exclude neutral text and unresolved mixed sentiment. Avoid generic product reviews, repetitive praise/complaint templates, and deliberate label-word stuffing. Do not prepend a sentiment label, star rating, or explanation.
Use at most 600 characters per example. Return only JSON with an examples array of strings; no labels or explanations.
